views.name: paper_author_membership
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  author.authorId AS authorId,
  author.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes
JOIN author ON writes.authorId = author.authorId
views.description: Denormalized relation of which authors wrote which papers: one row per (paperId, authorId) pairing, with authorName included for convenience. Supports cohort queries like 'papers with both author A and B'.

views.name: paper_author_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pam.paperId AS paperId,
  pam.authorId AS authorId,
  ab.authorName AS authorName
FROM paper_author_membership AS pam
JOIN author_basic AS ab
  ON pam.authorId = ab.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author association, exposing paperId and normalized author identifiers and names. Useful to filter or join papers by author(s) and to compute co-authorship conditions.

views.name: paper_with_authors_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorId, ',')
     FROM writes w
     JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
     WHERE w.paperId = p.paperId
    ), ''
  ) AS author_ids,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, '||')
     FROM writes w
     JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
     WHERE w.paperId = p.paperId
    ), ''
  ) AS author_names
FROM paper p
views.description: Denormalized relation: one row per paper with an array-like (or aggregated string) list of its authorIds and authorNames. Useful for quickly testing whether a paper's author set contains specific authors and for author-level filtering without repeated joins.

views.name: author_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  author.authorId AS authorId,
  TRIM(author.authorName) AS authorName
FROM author
views.description: Canonical author identity rows exposing author id and normalized name for joins and author-based filtering.

views.name: paper_basic_7

SELECT
  paper.paperId AS paperId,
  paper.title AS title,
  paper.venueId AS venueId,
  paper.journalId AS journalId,

FROM paper
views.description: Canonical paper rows exposing paper primary key and common descriptive columns (title, venue, journal, year) for filtering or reporting.

views.name: paper_writes_author_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pab.paperId AS paperId,
  pab.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName,
  p.numCitedBy AS paper_numCitedBy
FROM paper_author_link pab
JOIN author a ON pab.authorId = a.authorId
JOIN paper_basic p ON pab.paperId = p.paperId
views.description: One row per paper-author writing relationship, joining paper and author identity to enable author-based filtering and paper-level joins.

views.name: paper_authors_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorId, ',') AS author_ids_concat,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, ',') AS author_names_concat,
  COUNT(a.authorId) AS author_count
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
LEFT JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Aggregate view that collects author ids and names per paper as arrays/concatenated strings to enable existence checks of multiple authors on the same paper.

views.name: paper_author_link_10
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       w.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes AS w
JOIN author AS a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author association linking paper metadata with author identity (denormalized writes relation). Useful to filter or join papers by their authors.

views.name: paper_authors_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName,
  pa.author_count AS paper_author_count
FROM paper p
JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
LEFT JOIN paper_authors_agg pa ON p.paperId = pa.paperId
views.description: Cohort of authors for each paper: one row per paper-author with canonical author name and counts of authors per paper (precomputed author_count for quick filtering).

views.name: paper_author_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS author_count
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Aggregate counts of distinct authors per paper. One row per paper with the count of distinct authors and optionally other paper identifiers.

views.name: paper_authorship
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       a.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: Each row links a paper to one of its authors (denormalized writes join to author), useful for finding co-authorships and filtering papers by author attributes.

views.name: paper_authorship_14
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       w.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
views.description: One row per (paper, author) pair linking papers to their authors and exposing author and paper identifiers and names for filtering or joining.

views.name: paper_authors
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author authorship (denormalized writes join to author) exposing paperId, authorId, authorName. Enables finding papers co-authored by specific authors and counting distinct authors per paper.

views.name: paper_authorship_16
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  p.journalId AS journalId
FROM paper AS p
JOIN writes AS w
  ON p.paperId = w.paperId
views.description: One row per paper-author membership, denormalized to include paper and author identifiers and paper basic metadata (title, year, venue, journal). Useful to filter papers by author and to join author cohorts to papers.

views.name: author_coauthor_edges
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  wa.authorId AS authorId,
  wb.authorId AS coauthorId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wa.paperId) AS shared_paper_count
FROM writes wa
JOIN writes wb
  ON wa.paperId = wb.paperId
  AND wa.authorId < wb.authorId
GROUP BY wa.authorId, wb.authorId
UNION ALL
SELECT
  wb.authorId AS authorId,
  wa.authorId AS coauthorId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wa.paperId) AS shared_paper_count
FROM writes wa
JOIN writes wb
  ON wa.paperId = wb.paperId
  AND wa.authorId < wb.authorId
GROUP BY wb.authorId, wa.authorId
views.description: One row per unordered pair (edge) of co-authors who have co-authored at least one paper together. Exposes each author id and their coauthor id and the example/shared paper count (raw count of distinct papers they coauthored). Useful to build 1-hop and 2-hop collaboration networks.

views.name: paper_authors_18
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author association, joining paper to author so queries can filter/cohort by author and find co-authors.

views.name: paper_citation_classification
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) AS numCitedBy,
  -- normalized: divide by max(numCitedBy) across all papers; if max is 0 treat normalized as 0
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) IS NULL THEN 0.0
    WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE CAST(COALESCE(p.numCitedBy,0) AS FLOAT) / CAST((SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) AS FLOAT)
  END AS numCitedBy_normalized,
  -- citation_level buckets based on normalized value:
  CASE
    WHEN (CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE CAST(COALESCE(p.numCitedBy,0) AS FLOAT) / CAST((SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) AS FLOAT)
         END) >= 0.9 THEN 'very_high'
    WHEN (CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE CAST(COALESCE(p.numCitedBy,0) AS FLOAT) / CAST((SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) AS FLOAT)
         END) >= 0.7 THEN 'high'
    WHEN (CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE CAST(COALESCE(p.numCitedBy,0) AS FLOAT) / CAST((SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) AS FLOAT)
         END) >= 0.4 THEN 'medium'
    WHEN (CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) IS NULL THEN 0.0
            WHEN (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE CAST(COALESCE(p.numCitedBy,0) AS FLOAT) / CAST((SELECT MAX(COALESCE(numCitedBy,0)) FROM paper) AS FLOAT)
         END) > 0 THEN 'low'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS citation_level
FROM paper p
views.description: One row per paper with a normalized citation count and a derived citation_level bucket; NULL numCitedBy is treated as 0. Designed to provide classification rules reusable across queries.

views.name: venue_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  venue.venueId AS venueId,
  venue.venueName AS venueName
FROM venue
views.description: One row per venue from the venue table, exposing the venue primary key and name. Includes venues even if they have no papers.

views.name: paper_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  paper.paperId AS paperId,
  paper.venueId AS venueId,
  paper.title AS title,
  paper.year AS year,
  paper.numCiting AS numCiting,
  paper.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  paper.journalId AS journalId
FROM paper
views.description: One row per paper from the paper table exposing paper primary key and the venue foreign key (may be NULL). Keeps raw paper-level attributes for later grouping/filters.

views.name: venue_paper_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  v.venueId AS venueId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.paperId) AS paper_count
FROM venue v
LEFT JOIN paper p
  ON p.venueId = v.venueId
GROUP BY v.venueId
views.description: Aggregated counts of distinct papers per venue. Produces one row per venueId with the count of distinct paper.paperId associated to that venue. Includes venues with zero matching papers by left joining venue to paper.

views.name: paper_author_link_23
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       w.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId

views.name: paper_authors_agg_24

SELECT
  p.paperId,
  COUNT(w.authorId) AS author_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(w.authorId, ',') AS authorIds,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, ',') AS authorNames_concat
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
LEFT JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: One row per paper with an aggregated list/count of its authors (authorIds and authorNames exposed for filtering/grouping).

views.name: paper_authors_25
views.body_sql:
SELECT p.paperId AS paperId,
       a.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM paper p
JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: Mapping of papers to their authors with author identifiers and names. One row per (paper, author) association for author-based coauthorship and filtering.

views.name: paper_with_venue
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId,
  p.title,
  p.year,
  p.venueId,
  v.venueName,
  p.numCiting
FROM paper_rows p
LEFT JOIN venue_rows v ON p.venueId = v.venueId
views.description: Denormalized paper rows joined to venue name (if any). One row per paper including venueName to support presentation and venue-based filters.

views.name: paper_author_link_27
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId
FROM writes w
views.description: One row per authorship linking a paper to an author (denormalized writes relationship).

views.name: paper_author_links_28
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes AS w
JOIN author AS a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
views.description: One row per authorship linking a paper to an author, including author name and paper identifiers for joining and filtering.

views.name: paper_author_link_29
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName,
  p.title AS title,

views.name: authors_by_paper_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(w.authorId) AS author_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(w.authorId, ',') AS author_ids_concat,

FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
LEFT JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: For each paper, aggregated list/count of its authors (exposes authorId and authorName details) to enable fast identification of papers having specific author combinations.

views.name: paper_authorship_31
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  writes.authorId AS authorId
FROM writes
views.description: One row per (paper, author) authorship linking papers to their authors via writes; exposes paper and author identifiers for set operations and joins.

views.name: paper_dataset_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  paperDataset.paperId AS paperId,
  paperDataset.datasetId AS datasetId
FROM paperDataset
views.description: One row per paper-dataset association. Denormalized link exposing paper id and dataset id for every association between a paper and a dataset.

views.name: datasets_per_paper
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pd.datasetId) AS distinct_dataset_count
FROM paper AS p
LEFT JOIN paperDataset AS pd ON p.paperId = pd.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Count of distinct datasets associated with each paper. One row per paper with the distinct count of datasetId values linked to that paper.

views.name: papers_with_author
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       w.authorId AS authorId
FROM writes w
JOIN paper p ON p.paperId = w.paperId
JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author association for papers that have an author; used to get cohorts of papers by particular authors.

views.name: paper_author_counts_35
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS author_count
FROM paper AS p
LEFT JOIN writes AS w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Number of distinct authors per paper (co-author counts can be derived by subtracting one for a particular author). One row per paper with raw count of authors.

views.name: paper_basic_36
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.title AS title,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  p.year AS year,

  p.numCiting AS numCiting,

views.description: One row per paper with core identifying columns (title, venue, year, journal and citation counts). Useful as the canonical paper entity to select paperId for many queries.

views.name: paper_author_link_37

SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  writes.authorId AS authorId,
  author.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes
JOIN author ON author.authorId = writes.authorId
views.description: One row per authorship linking a paper to an author (denormalized join of writes and author). Exposes authorId, authorName, paperId for filtering/cohort definition of papers by author attributes.

views.name: paper_writes_author
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  writes.authorId AS authorId

views.description: Denormalized relation linking papers to authors via the writes table. One row per (paperId, authorId) pair indicating that the author wrote the paper.

views.name: paper_coauthor_counts
views.body_sql:

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS authors_concat

views.name: paper_writes_author_40
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  writes.authorId AS authorId
FROM writes
views.description: One row per authorship linking paper to author (denormalized writes relation). Exposes paperId and authorId for membership/cohort checks.

views.name: keyphrase_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  keyphraseId,
  keyphraseName
FROM keyphrase
views.description: Canonical row-level view of keyphrases exposing id and canonical name.

views.name: paper_keyphrase_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  paperKeyphrase.paperId AS paperId,
  paperKeyphrase.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId
FROM paperKeyphrase
views.description: Row-level link between papers and keyphrases: one row per (paperId, keyphraseId) association.

views.name: keyphrase_paper_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  k.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pk.paperId) AS paper_count
FROM keyphrase AS k
LEFT JOIN paperKeyphrase AS pk
  ON pk.keyphraseId = k.keyphraseId
GROUP BY k.keyphraseId
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of distinct papers per keyphrase (one row per keyphraseId). Keeps zero-count keyphrases when left-joined from keyphrase_row.

views.name: paper_author_link_44
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       w.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
views.description: Denormalized mapping of papers to their authors (one row per paper-author), exposing author and paper keys and author name.

views.name: paper_citation_impact_label
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pb.paperId AS paperId,
  pb.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  CASE
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy = 0 THEN 'none'
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'low'
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 'moderate'
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy BETWEEN 21 AND 100 THEN 'high'
    WHEN pb.numCitedBy > 100 THEN 'very_high'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS impact_label
FROM paper_basic pb
views.description: Assigns an impact label to each paper based on its raw numCitedBy value according to external knowledge rules. Keeps one row per paper and exposes the raw count and derived categorical label.

views.name: paper_author_link_46
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  w.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes AS w
JOIN author AS a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: One row per authorship linking a paper to an author, with author and paper identifiers and author name for easy filtering and joining.

views.name: paper_authors_agg_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(w.authorId) AS author_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(w.authorId, ',') AS author_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, ', ') AS author_names
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
LEFT JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: For each paper, the set and count of associated authors (authorIds and concatenated names) — supports existence and co-authorship checks without re-joining authors every time.
